description: Use this when someone names a plant of West or Central Africa by its scientific name or a common name (for example "Azadirachta indica", "sobolo" or "prekese") and you need to know whether the KwekuAnansi herbarium has a card for it. It returns the matching cards with family and rank, and says plainly when a plant is not in the herbarium yet. Do not use it to identify a plant from a description or a photograph, or for a plant from outside Africa: it matches names as written, and a plant that is not found may be there under another name.

name.description: The plant's scientific name ("Vernonia amygdalina") or a common name ("bitter leaf").

name: herbarium.find
title: Find a plant in the KwekuAnansi herbarium
